title: Kernel Panic on 6.17.3
body: I saw a kernel panic for the first time today. Was quiet shocked, thought machine was infected with malware, because I didn't know about systemds graphical bluescreen. After reboot i realized, it happens again after a few minutes (3-5) every time I boot up the machine.
